question: Under what condition is even the wise person said to be burning, with reference to nectar and the tip of juice?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of juice as an instrument.
Even the wise person, while burning, is indicated by api.
inference: Even the wise person, burning by means related to the tip of juice at the tip of nectar, is in that condition.
uncertainties: Exact procedure and result not specified in this verse
plain_english: Even the wise person, burning, takes the tip of nectar with the tip of juice.
